item.title: Heavy metal safe dumped on small garden on Railway Avenue, 11th August
item.description:
The safe was dumped onto one of the two small gardens roughly 2 weeks ago and is still there. The gardens back onto the Rotherhithe Station and are one of the entrances to the Adams Garden Estate from Railway Avenue (opposite the junction of Kenning Street). A neighbour and myself who live on the Swan Road estate have been looking after the two small gardens for some years which local people are very grateful for. We are always cleaning rubbish from the small gardens however we are unable to move the safe. Due to its size it is an eyesore and is preventing us from working on that patch of garden.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Railway Avenue, Rotherhithe, Greater London

item.title: No Zebra crossing in A4003 and Cavendish Road, 11th August
item.description:
Dear Sir or Madam: There is no traffic light or pedestrian sign/road mark for this road. This road connects queen’s park and kilburn, a lot of people crossing this path every day, and I have witnessed 3 incidents that happened/almost happened this week, in which that motorcycle and cyclist almost hit pedestrians because there is no sign /road mark/ traffic light for them to note. and after I logged into TfL, there are many report and enquiries for adding a pedestrian traffic light to this crossing. After consulting with them, TfL informed me that you could assist this further. It will be great for the community and local economy if you could invest and make some change in this cross! Many thanks! Kind Regards, William
Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Willesden Lane, Kilburn, London
Report on FixMyStreet
